name: bitcoin-whitepaper
description: The Bitcoin whitepaper — a narrated, interactive, fully translated edition of Satoshi Nakamoto's 2008 paper.

scripts.build: mkdir -p dist/whitepaper && cp index.html dist/ && cp -R public/whitepaper/. dist/whitepaper/
scripts.build:i18n: node scripts/i18n/build-locale.mjs es zh ja ko fr de pt ru ar it hi pl nl he
